caption: The figure shows report.pdf (1.5 MB, 1572864 bytes) becoming a content URI via FileProvider, then an ACTION_SEND intent carrying FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION. The dashed arrow is the viewer pulling exactly 1572864 bytes with openInputStream.

spec.title: Sharing a file safely
spec.aria: A report.pdf of 1.5 MB (1572864 bytes) goes through FileProvider to a content URI, then into an ACTION_SEND intent with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION, and the PDF viewer calls openInputStream to read exactly 1572864 bytes.
